diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the model settled on the exact blocks for each activity (0800-1000, 1000-1200, 1200-1400, 1400-1600) without needing any of the hidden information. This suggests that the model is defaulting to a simple equal-split heuristic, where it evenly distributes the activities across the available blocks, which does not require any coordination or access to private information.

C1.why: The inspection-sheet requirement changes the generator load test from an uncommitted activity to the exact first block, 0800-1000, and supplies the fact required for the cited justification.

C2.why: The custodian and technician availability changes the clinic refrigeration transfer to the exact 1000-1200 block.

C3.why: The stabilized-output and technician requirement changes the communications-battery recharge to the exact 1200-1400 block.

C4.why: The manifold-connection sequence changes water-point pumping to the exact final block, 1400-1600.

commitments.detail: Each activity will be scheduled within the available two-hour blocks during the power-control period.

fix_instructions: Tighten the constraints on Check C1 by requiring that the generator load test block cannot be the same as the clinic refrigeration transfer block. Similarly, for Check C2, restrict the clinic refrigeration transfer block to be different from the communications-battery recharge block. For Check C3, prevent the communications-battery recharge block from overlapping with the water-point pumping block. Finally, for Check C4, ensure that the water-point pumping block is distinct from the generator load test block. This will force the model to consider the hidden information and make decisions based on the interactions between the agents' private facts.
